title: TomTam's Tweaks
description: A minecraft mod to fill the gaps I am missing in my games.
body:
A mod I've written to fill gaps in my Vanilla+ playthroughs. I am planning to add other things if I run into other QoL improvements I am missing.

## What's added
- A lumber axe that cuts down entire trees in one go
- A mini coal item that smelts a single item
